regions.merged_text: Many thanks to you and our dear friends who has so generously remembered me in their prayers and other alms - especially in their Holy Communions, Masses and rosaries. I have been including them in my prayers and holy Masses and will offer my next "Free Mass" for your and their individual intentions and holy guidance. ..... . I would like to write each one but that would not permit me to perform more urgent duties. So I'll have to be brief. Praying that you each and all be blessed with God holy grace and health for the coming privileged holy season and feasts - Immaculate Con- ception - Christmas - New Years and following again around.
